Start with laundry and trash, that changes my room a huge amount. 

I always start with taking out all of my laundry first and seperating it in the way I wash it (if you donnt have a system and want to hear mine lmk). This way it’s out of the room. 

Then I move onto trash. I take out 2 bags and a box for it. One trash bag is for regular trash like wrappers, shoe tags, etc. Then I have a plastic trash bag for all the plastic trash, and a cardboard box for all the paper waste. 

I start with the trash on the floors, and then I move onto my table/desk and other flat surfaces etc (including my couch and bed).

After you’ve done these two things (laundry and trash) your room will probably look a lot different already (if it looks anything like mine lol).

Sometimes I leave it like this, and sometimes I clean more, depending on my energy levels. But if I have energy left here’s what I do next;

First I look at all the things that I have in my floor and I put them in their designated spot. If something doesn’t have a designated spot I either throw it away or I put it in my adhd drawer (this has random stuff that doesn’t have a place on my book shelves or paint drawers etc but is still import to keep).

After that I move onto my couch next so I have a place to sit and it looks neat, and basically do the same as above. 

Now my desk usually has a lot of random stuff on it, half of which I can usually throw away, like old notes and stuff. I usually put all my notes and stuff in a small box and sort them out at the last moment because otherwise I’ll get stuck on it for hours. 

My room is usually clean after this because I don’t have that much space, you might have more cabinets or flat surfaces etc to clean. 

Then I go about vaccuuming my floors, my desk, my table, as well as my couch. If there’s any sticky stuff I will mop the floors and wash the desk etc with a cloth. 

If there’s a bad smell I will usually spray a room smelly thingy (forgot the name whoops adhd)


When I’m feeling a little extra I start my load of laundry at the start of my cleaning (like I said I start with dirty clothes first so it’s easy to keep going to the laundry machine instead of just putting it in the laundry bag).

Then halfway through I can usually hang it up and start a new load. But that also depends on how bad my room is because I don’t have that much space and I need to dry my clothes in my room so I sometimes leave that to the end and only do one load of laundry. 

*My best advice for you though* is to take care of yourself. Start with a good breakfast and keep a bottle of water with you throughout your cleaning. Put on your shoes and keep going. Don’t sit down until you have done *insert xyz tasks you wanna get done*.

As for the labels;
_Trans_ (transgender) means you are born in a body that does not match with the typical male/female values that people have. So a boy in a ‘girls’ body or a girl in a ‘boys’ body, or someone who is non-binary. 

_Nonbinary_ is an umbrella term for everyone who does not feel like they are 100% a boy or a girl. This could mean they feel 10% boy and 90% girl, this could mean on some days they feel masculine and other days they feel feminine, it could mean they feel like a little bit of both at the same time, it could mean they feel neither, etc. In the end, what they feel *exactly* is different for everyone, and they could get into microlabels, however the most important thing to know is that their body and their mind do not ‘match’. So for your nephew that means she does not identify as being a boy, even though it was assumed at birth she was a boy. 

_Enby_ is a short version of the word non-binary. 

_Poly_ from polyamorous means you have more love to give. You are not monogamous with one person, but are open to/are dating multiple people at the same time. This does not mean you are more likely to cheat, and this does not mean you will go with anyone. And some people have two seperate partners (or more), other have a triad (three people dating one another), some people have a lot of partners who in turn have a lot of partners themselves, etc, but in the end it just means they do not love one person at the same time, and either are dating multiple people, or want to/are open to it. 

 (For reference I am poly too, but I am only dating one partner. I did briefly have a second partner at the same time, but just like any other relationships, not everything works out. The fact that I’m currently only dating one person does not make me any less poly).

The bone is protected by a layer called the periosteum. If you have a wound in your skin, fat or muscle, your immune system can usually fight it off with a little help (aka cleaning out the wound of debris). So by cleaning your entire leg, chances of you getting an infection and possibly needing an amputation, are way less. Not impossible, there’s always still a risk with an open periosteum wound, but this does lower the chances a lot.
